newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Lace cancels new share plan.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Lace cancels new share plan.

text.p: Nippon Lace Co Ltd said on Friday that it would cancel its plan for a third-party allocation of new shares.
"We have decided to cancel the plan as designated investors cannot procure funds (for the share allocation)," Nippon Lace said in a statement.
Last month, the lace manufacturer said that it would go ahead with a previously cancelled plan for a third-party allocation of new shares to two investors in early April.
Under the plan, the company said it would issue six million new shares at 280 yen per share to two investors, with a payment date set for April 7.
Nippon Lace's shares closed up eight yen at 249 yen on Friday.
